hook: Turn any SVG into a spinning gold coin

beats.say: Minted is a free, MIT-licensed SwiftUI component that turns SVG artwork into a three-dimensional gold medal, built for things like achievement badges and commemorative coins.
It offers four coin shapes, can engrave text, and can even make coins from images. You do not need to prepare any 3D model at all.
Geometry is generated from your 2D paths, with enamel inlays, studio reflections and spins, so your app ships zero model files.
